description: GT2N — open-source 2nm GAA nanosheet PDK from Prof. Azad Naeemi's group at Georgia Tech (ISCAS 2026; PDK/BSPDN/CAD follow-ups at MLCAD 2026). The most advanced node in this catalog (predictive, like asap7 — not a real-foundry process) and the first here with a BACKSIDE power delivery network: gt2_tech.lef carries the BPR + backside stack (BPR/BV0/BM1..BM4/BRDL) above the frontside M0..M6, and gt2_fspdn_tech.lef is the frontside-PDN variant of the same process — pick one per design, they are alternatives, not layers of one stack. Devices are 3-stack nanosheets (NFIN=3, Lg 14 nm) in TWO sheet WIDTHS (13 nm / 31 nm) x FIVE Vt flavors (HVT > SVT > LVT > ULVT > ELVT) = 10 std-cell libraries of ~69 characterized cells on a 6-track 0.144 um row. The thermal-calibrated device model card is per WIDTH/Vt as well as per corner (device/tt/gt2_w31_lvt_tt.sp), so it does NOT belong in corners[].models (shared across cell libraries): each card is carried by its own library in cell_libraries[].models, which REPLACES corners[].models for that library rather than adding to it. This PDK is why that field exists. PREVIEW: the initial release characterizes ONE corner (tt, 0.7 V, 25 C) — README says 3 corners are under development — and ships no behavioral Verilog and no SRAM (compiler/library announced for a future release). DRC/LVS decks are Synopsys IC Validator runsets and parasitics are StarRC (.itf/.nxtgrd) + QRC (.ict/.tch), i.e. the sign-off collateral is commercial-tool-shaped; no KLayout/Magic/Netgen deck ships, so vyges-drc / vyges-lvs have nothing to consume yet. Mirrored under github.com/vyges-tools/gt2n (daily merge-based upstream sync); upstream carries no tags, so the pin is a commit on main and versions[] stays hand-maintained. Paths are relative to $GT2N_PDK, a clone of that mirror.
